Hi Markus,

Thanks for sending the initial SIG package yesterday. Aurora's security team reviewed the Access Controls section and had a couple of specific asks so we can close our assessment:

1) A SCIM attribute mapping file showing the user attributes Redwood syncs from our IdP and how they map to Redwood roles (e.g., externalId, email, department -> role).

Could you point us to the exact files or, if easier, provide a short checklist with timelines for delivering the items? We have a procurement milestone next week so anything you can turn around quickly would be appreciated.

Hi Elena — attaching the CSV and matrix requested. Quick notes inline: 

- redwood_scim_attribute_map_v1.csv: Columns are IdP_attribute, Redwood_field, required, transform. Example: email -> email (required), groups -> role (optional, mapped via group-to-role rules).
- least_privilege_matrix.xlsx: Lists roles (Admin, Infra Admin, App Admin, Support) and which actions each can perform; service-account creation is limited to Infra Admin + automated provisioning pipeline (requires two-step approval).
- sig_response_snippet.pdf: Excerpt from our SIG responses describing SAML behavior and MFA decision flow.

On the MFA point: by default we accept the IdP assertion for MFA (so if Aurora enforces MFA, that satisfies our requirement). We also support enforcement at Redwood for customers who prefer an additional control — that is an opt-in setting during onboarding.

If you want, we can schedule a short 20-minute walkthrough tomorrow to step through the CSV and mapping logic.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Security Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
